Railway symbols pass through near Zhuzhou, among which one railway is roughly north-south in direction, passes through or closely adjoins Zhuzhou, and extends northward and southward. Then reason: The question stem requires taking a train from Zhuzhou to Xi'an by the shortest distance. When leaving Zhuzhou for the northern inland direction, one should first use the north-south railway trunk line that passes through Zhuzhou in the figure. Combining knowledge of China's main railway trunk lines, the north-south railway trunk line passing through Zhuzhou is the Beijing-Guangzhou Railway. Therefore the answer is the Beijing-Guangzhou Railway.
